fields.headline: Adds $450,000 to a City of Oakland summer internship stipend grant, raising it to $675,000 and extending it to June 2025
fields.summary: This amendment to a grant agreement with the City of Oakland adds funding for stipends for students in summer internships in the Linked Learning pathway program Exploring College, Career, and Community Options (ECCCO) at 15 schools, and extends the grant term to June 30, 2025. The attached amendment sets the grant at up to $225,000 for each of three fiscal years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25), so this vote adds $450,000 to the original $225,000, for a total of $675,000. The agenda text lists only $225,000. The funding source is the Oakland Fund for Children and Youth.

25-0567.note: Corrected: the agenda lists $225,000, which is one year's award. The attached amendment adds $450,000 (for FY 2023-24 and FY 2024-25), raising the grant from $225,000 to $675,000.
25-0567.sourceIssue: The text gives $225,000 for the amendment, but the attached amendment sets the grant at up to $225,000 in each of three fiscal years: it adds $450,000 and raises the total from $225,000 to $675,000.
